plaintiffs.name: Full name as the plaintiff gives it (person, business, or public entity)
plaintiffs.phone: Phone exactly as given in the case (keep its digits/format); empty if none
plaintiffs.street: Street address only, e.g. 655 S Fair Oaks Ave
plaintiffs.mailing_street: Only if a DIFFERENT mailing address is stated; else empty

defendants.name: Defendant's full name
defendants.mailing_street: Only if a different mailing address is stated

agent.name: ONLY when the defendant is a corporation, LLC, or public entity: the person/agent for service of process; else omit or empty

claim_amount: Amount claimed as a number, e.g. 1500 (no court costs or service fees)
why_owed: Item 3a: one or two plain sentences on why the defendant owes the money, in the plaintiff's first-person voice, using the case's own facts
incident_date: Item 3b: the single date it happened, ONLY if the case gives one specific date; else empty
period_start: Item 3b: start of the period when the case gives a span instead of one date; else empty
period_through: Item 3b: end of that period; else empty
how_calculated: Item 3c: how the amount was calculated, from the case's facts (e.g. which document lists the amount, what was added up)
needs_more_space: true only if 3a/3c cannot fit (about 4-5 lines of ~100 chars each) and an attachment will be made; else false
asked_no_explanation: Item 4: only if the plaintiff did NOT ask the defendant to pay, why not; else empty
venue_other_specify: Item 5e text, only when the venue basis is 'other'; else empty
venue_zip: Item 6: ZIP of the place the venue box refers to, if known (filing where the defendant lives -> the defendant's ZIP; where the contract was made/injury happened -> that place's ZIP); else empty
public_claim_filed_date: Item 8: date a written claim was filed with the public entity, only when suing one; else empty
court_name_address: Page 1 court name and street address, ONLY if the case states the court; else empty
filing_date: The date the plaintiff signs/files the form, as stated in the case; else empty
